source_trace.title: Tim Hortons' parent rolls up its sleeves to fix struggling business

impact_scope_evidence.quote: The coffee chain is in the middle of a turnaround after several years of disappointing sales growth.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: The article discusses Tim Hortons' challenges in its home market, Canada, and its efforts to improve its business through various initiatives. These efforts are industry-wide as they relate to the broader restaurant and food service sector.

impact_scope_evidence.quote: Shares of its parent company Restaurant Brands slid 3% in morning trading Monday, despite strong performances from its other two chains, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen and Burger King.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: The article specifically mentions the parent company, Restaurant Brands, and its stock performance, indicating a company-specific impact.

impact_scope_evidence.quote: Tim Hortons also recognized the importance of the drive-thru in its renovations of hundreds of stores.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: The article highlights the importance of drive-thru service in the restaurant industry, which is a common feature across the sector, indicating an industry-wide impact.
